title: What is an Error Boundary
question: What is a React Error Boundary and what kind of errors does it catch?
searchIntent: how does error boundary work react
realWorldScenario: Without an Error Boundary, a JavaScript error in one widget crashes the entire React app — boundaries contain the damage.

title: Error Boundary requires class component
question: Why must Error Boundaries be class components in React and which lifecycle methods do they use?
searchIntent: why error boundary is class component react
realWorldScenario: There is no hook equivalent for `componentDidCatch` — this is one of the few remaining valid use cases for class components.

title: Errors NOT caught by Error Boundaries
question: What types of errors does a React Error Boundary NOT catch?
seoKeywords: errors not caught by error boundary react
searchIntent: what errors does error boundary not catch react
realWorldScenario: Errors in event handlers, async code (fetch failures), and server-side rendering are NOT caught — only render-time errors are.

title: Fallback UI in Error Boundaries
question: How do you render a fallback UI when an Error Boundary catches an error?
searchIntent: how to render fallback in react error boundary
realWorldScenario: Showing a friendly 'Something went wrong' message instead of a blank white screen when a widget errors.

title: react-error-boundary library
question: What is the `react-error-boundary` npm package and what does it provide over writing a custom class component?
searchIntent: react error boundary library vs custom
realWorldScenario: The library provides an `<ErrorBoundary>` component with `fallback` prop and `onError` callback, avoiding the boilerplate of writing a class component.
